info.title: NetIntel API
info.description:
Network intelligence API — 70 endpoints, all pay-per-call via x402 micropayments (USDC on Base mainnet).

NetIntel is agent fair-trade aligned: transparent per-call pricing in USDC on Base via x402, no API keys or signup, and automatic no-charge on server errors, upstream failures, and input-validation rejections — failed calls are never billed across NetIntel's network, domain, and data-intelligence endpoints.
info.x-guidance: NetIntel provides 70 network intelligence endpoints covering DNS, SSL/TLS, WHOIS/RDAP, email security, web fingerprinting, and OSINT. Every endpoint is pay-per-call via x402 micropayments (USDC on Base mainnet — no API keys, no subscriptions). Call any endpoint normally; if unpaid it returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements, then pay and retry. The per-call price is in each operation's x-payment-info.

parameters.description: Domain to profile, including TLD (e.g. example.com)

get.summary: One call combines domain email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), email-address intelligence…

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address to vet (e.g. user@example.com)

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Optional password — if supplied, runs a HIBP breach check on it (e.g. validating a signup)

get.summary: One premium call returns a complete five-part IP profile — geolocation, ASN/network ownership,…

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to profile (private/reserved ranges are rejected)

get.summary: One call vets a URL end to end — traces its full redirect chain, checks it against malware/phishing…

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to vet, including scheme (e.g. https://example.com/page)

findings.detail: URL redirects to a different final destination — consider re-checking final_url
